actions.action: true peak +1.5 dBTP (this decoded lossy file already clips on playback): end the master chain with a true-peak limiter, ceiling -1.0 dBTP, then re-encode

tips: no stop-downs: 4 of 7 references drop the sound out for 0.2-1 s right before a big hit; try one before the biggest visual change at 0:15.93
voice detected in 86% of windows: duck music 3-6 dB under the voice and keep SFX out of 1-4 kHz while it speaks

metrics.label: integrated loudness
metrics.why: how loud the film plays next to other launch videos: X, LinkedIn and site autoplay do not normalise, YouTube turns masters above -14 LUFS down

metrics.label: true peak
metrics.why: a master above -1 dBTP clips once encoded to AAC / MP3 (a decoded lossy file above 0 dBTP already clips on playback): crackle on the biggest hits
actions: true peak +1.5 dBTP (this decoded lossy file already clips on playback): end the master chain with a true-peak limiter, ceiling -1.0 dBTP, then re-encode

metrics.label: realness (p_real)
metrics.why: the reference launch films use real recordings and produced music; next to them, code-synthesized sound reads as cheap and generic

metrics.label: music presence
metrics.why: the references are music-led: one continuous track carries the energy and hides edit seams

metrics.label: onset on visual events +-100ms
metrics.why: a cut or big visual change with no sound under it feels dead; viewers expect sound on motion

metrics.label: loudness range
metrics.why: how much the loudness swings: launch films keep the body consistently strong

metrics.label: loudest 3 s above integrated
metrics.why: how far the loudest 3 s stick out above the average level

metrics.label: time to first sound
metrics.why: silence at the start loses autoplay viewers: the references sound at once

metrics.label: dead air at the end
metrics.why: dead air after the sound stops makes the ending feel unfinished

metrics.label: longest silent gap inside
metrics.why: a silent hole mid-film reads as a mistake unless it is a deliberate stop-down

metrics.label: final moment vs integrated
metrics.why: the logo / end-card moment should land at body level or above, not fade away

metrics.label: onset density
metrics.why: rhythmic activity: too sparse feels empty, too dense feels cluttered

metrics.label: salient hit density
metrics.why: punch: salient hits mark the key moments; without them nothing lands

metrics.label: opening level (first 10%)
metrics.why: how the film opens: the references open close to body level (one builds up)

metrics.label: closing level (last 10%)
metrics.why: how the last 10 % sit against the body

metrics.label: final fade / ring-out length
metrics.why: launch films end on a sting or a hard out; long fade-outs lose the button

metrics.label: sub 20-60 Hz share
metrics.why: sub (20-60 Hz) weight under hits and music

metrics.label: low 60-250 Hz share
metrics.why: low end body (60-250 Hz)

metrics.label: low-mid 250-1k share
metrics.why: low-mids (250 Hz-1 kHz): too much = muddy, too little = hollow

metrics.label: mid 1-4 kHz share
metrics.why: mids (1-4 kHz): where clicks and voice cut through phone speakers

metrics.label: presence 4-8 kHz share
metrics.why: presence (4-8 kHz): bite of transients, clicks and typing

metrics.label: air 8-16 kHz share
metrics.why: air (8-16 kHz): openness; missing air sounds muffled or low-bitrate

metrics.label: stereo width (side vs mid)
metrics.why: stereo width: near-mono sounds small, too wide collapses on phones

metrics.label: voice / speech presence
metrics.why: voice share (4 of 7 references have a voice-over, 3 are music-only)

metrics.label: tempo
metrics.why: music tempo

metrics.label: position of the loudest 3 s
metrics.why: where the loudest moment sits

metrics.label: final hit ring-out
metrics.why: how long the final hit rings out

metrics.label: stop-downs
metrics.why: short drop-outs before hits (4 of 7 references use them)

metrics.label: visual events (cuts, big changes)
metrics.why: edit pace (visual events per second)

metrics.label: visual events with a salient hit +-100 ms
metrics.why: visual events with a salient hit (references: near chance)

metrics.label: visual events with an onset +-1 frame
metrics.why: visual events with an onset within one frame (references: near chance)

metrics.label: visual events on the beat grid +-70 ms
metrics.why: visual events on the beat grid (references: near chance)

metrics.label: brightness (median spectral centroid)
metrics.why: perceived brightness of the mix

metrics.label: L/R correlation
metrics.why: L/R correlation (1 = mono)
